method: Actual image-viewer inspection of local component renders and four reference images; frozen design and architecture read.
scope: Isolated motor and propeller. Full-assembly review pending.

findings.observation: Model outer blades taper continuously into a leaf-like tip; reference GF1207 retains a wider round-cornered paddle terminal and a straighter outer edge on one side.
findings.action: Revise estimated outer chord/sweep stations, retaining chord farther outward and using a short rounded terminal cap. Match reference handedness and azimuth for comparison.
findings.uncertainty: Reference perspective and pitch affect projected chord; contour is not a verified CAD trace.
findings.verification: Inspect corrected top and oblique silhouettes; integrator rechecks evaluated maximum radius after twist/sweep.

findings.observation: Open three-spoke hub is supported, but the outer cylinder appears modestly narrow relative to rotor and motor in both references.
findings.action: Main integrator may test prop_hub_radius=2.4 mm, comparing 2.5 mm if needed, preserving the published hub height/bore and shared seating.
findings.uncertainty: Perspective, transmission and background affect apparent edges. Trial values are not measured or verified dimensions.
findings.verification: Accept only if both matched top and oblique views improve; recheck blade-root transitions and real apertures.

findings.observation: Hub and blades render as frosted grey with weak edge contrast; references have clearer transmission and stronger clear-polymer edge highlights.
findings.action: Tune transmission/roughness and inspection background after contour changes. Do not alter blade thickness solely to fix appearance.
findings.uncertainty: Studio lighting, background and retouching contribute; polished catalog imagery may exaggerate clarity.

supported_observations.observation: Distinct lower mount, terminal plate, neck, short silver can and raised open crown agree qualitatively with the family diagram. No layer-height correction justified by this pass.
Purple open crown and copper visibility match current Racing catalog target; physical specimen has turquoise accents, so its color is not authoritative for this target.
Three blades, spanwise twist, raised bored hub and three real hub apertures are present and qualitatively supported.

limitations: No camera calibration or aligned silhouette metric
No physical object measurement or original manufacturer CAD
Perspective photographs cannot certify numerical dimensions
Motor internals, exact airfoil, camber, twist and hidden details remain estimated
Reference manufacturer's imagery may include renders or retouching
